chapter.verse: Pasian' teeltuam mite a upna uh ahi zongin, biakna lungsim tawh a kituak thumaan thutak cingtaaktak a theihna uh ahi zongin, amau' phattuam nadingin Pasian' sila leh Jesu Khris ii sawltak ahi keimah Paul in,
a zuau theilo Pasian' piak, khanghunte a kipat ma-a a kamciam ahi tawntung nuntakna lamen kawmin, leh
tu-in zong eite' Honpa Pasian' thupiakna tawh kei' tunga hong ki-ap thutangkona tungtawnin ama' seh hun ah ama' thu sunga a hong lahkhiat tua tawntung nuntakna lamen kawmin,
i neihtaang thu-upna ah ka ta taktak ahi Titus kong hopih hi. Pa Pasian leh eite' Honpa Khris Jesu' kiangpan hehpihna leh nopna lemna hong tung ta hen.
Crete Tuikulh ah kong nusiatna a hang pen a kisam lai thute na lepsiang nading leh kong vaikhaksa bangin khua khempeuh ah pawlpi makaite na seh nading ahi hi.
Pawlpi makaite pen a kawkbaanglo leh zi khat bek a nei hiding uh hi. A tate uh zong cilesa uangtat, thutangpek ci-in mawhsak nading a omlo, a muanhuai mi hiding uh hi.
A hang pen pawlpi sya cih ciangin Pasian' innsung thuvan ahih mah bangin kawkbaanglo hiding hi. A kihisak, a lungtom, zu khamin a kitom, mi a zawhthawhbawl, thumaanlo sum a iplah, hilo ding hi.
Tua sangsikin pawlpi makai cih pen zinleleng do a siam, thuhoih lahoih a deih, ngaihsut thulam tawn, a thutang, a siangtho, pumpi a ki-ukzo, hiding hi.
Thuhilhna kilekkim tawh mite a hanthawn thei, tua banah thu a nial mite a khialhna uh a laktel thei, ahih nadingin a muantaak hilhcianna thu, kiptak a pom hiding hi.
A hang pen thutangpekte, thu a mawk gengente leh mikhemte tampitak om a, vun-atte pawl pan hi deuh uh hi.
Tua mite in a zumhuai thumaanlo sum a ngahnop manun a hilhhuailo thute hilhcianna tawh innkuante a bupin nawngkaisak uh ahih manin tua mite a kam uh hukcipsak ding ahi hi.
Crete mite khat, amau' laka kamsang khat in, “Crete mite a tawntungin zuau a phuakte, gamsa huaisiate, thadah uisante,” ci ngei hi.
Hih teci panna a maan ahi hi. Tua ahih manin upna thu ah a kilekkim ahih nadingun a khialhna uh khauhtak laktel in.
Jew khanglui tuanthute hitaleh thumaan thutak a nolh mite' thupiaknate hitaleh a thudon loh nadingun gen in.

A siangthote' adingin na khempeuh a siangtho hi pah a, a thanghuaite leh a umlo mite' ading ahihleh a siangtho khat zong om lo hi. Amaute' khuaphawkna lungsim leh kitheihtawmna lungsim, a nam nihin a thanghuai ahi hi.
Pasian a thei-in kigen uh a, ahih hangin a sepna uh tawh Pasian nial uh ahih manin a muhthadahhuai, a thumanglo, nahoih sepna namkim' ading a tehcinglo ahi uh hi.
